summary: Expose the attributed finite-N Weideman approximation as an explicit numerical variant, while the canonical maintained plasma-dispersion API remains the default scientific relation.

identity.relation: Complex argument and approximation order to finite-order Faddeeva response
identity.definition: Approximate w(z)=exp(-z^2)erfc(-i*z) with the source finite-N FFT/rational construction, lower-half reflection and corrected imaginary-axis erfcx evaluation.
identity.geometry: Complex argument plane with representability limits.
identity.boundary: Analytic continuation with a source lower-half reflection.
assumptions: N is a positive integer controlling the numerical approximation, not a physical parameter.
Finite-order approximation has a bounded tested domain, not a global arbitrary-N error guarantee.

inputs.name: z
inputs.constraints: Native MAT shape: scalar becomes (1,1), a 1D vector becomes (1,n), higher-dimensional array shape is retained.

inputs.name: transport
inputs.description: Optional explicit native executor; None uses the packaged resource closure.
inputs.constraints: Requires a compatible external Octave runtime. No original checkout or network is consulted.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: NativeResult whose state[w] is the complex Faddeeva approximation; receipt is execution metadata.
outputs.dtype: NativeResult with float64 or complex128 w according to native result representation
outputs.constraints: Unrepresentable nonfinite results raise rather than silently becoming a valid approximation.

preconditions: Finite inputs satisfying the declared units and shapes.
supported: Default N16 and explicit positive finite orders, including pure imaginary and lower-half arguments.
excluded: Canonical shape preservation or a global accuracy guarantee for arbitrary N.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError or a missing required mapping key rejects invalid inputs.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Dependency, numerical-library, or native-runtime errors propagate; no silent alternate provider.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial result is returned on failure.

provenance.lineage_summary: Explicit finite-order numerical variant of the PDRK beammode Faddeeva implementation; corrected imaginary-axis overflow is independently checked against the maintained canonical relation.
provenance.license_status: pending-human-decision: source attribution is retained; redistribution permission and human scientific endorsement are unresolved.

example.description: Evaluate a finite-order two by two array.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic.pdrk.special import evaluate_faddeeva_finite_order
r = evaluate_faddeeva_finite_order(np.array([[0, 1j], [-1j, 1+2j]]), N=32)
assert r.state["w"].shape == (2, 2)
example.expected: Finite complex response with the declared native two-dimensional shape.

scope: Independent canonical comparison, large imaginary argument and mixed 2x2/order cases.
Original-source finite-order fidelity and source-double typed input ABI.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded derived scientific qualification exists. Integrated public signatures, executable examples, and final installed-candidate acceptance require separate verification.
known_limitations: Bounded mixed-domain qualification gave N16 error within 1e-6 and N64 within 2e-13; these are not universal bounds.
Requires an external compatible Octave runtime, unlike the canonical SciPy-backed relation.
